question: What's new this week in Agentic AI hiring trends and in tooling/frameworks worth knowing about?

what_to_study.summary: Geographic & remote‑first spread: hiring concentrations in Silicon Valley, Seattle, Austin, Toronto, London, Berlin with rising remote‑first listings
On‑device autonomous assistants: Mika demonstrates a fully local Android AI assistant that can drive apps and browse the web without cloud calls
Domain‑specific agent demo: Roblox‑AI‑Studio‑Agent shows agents specialised for niche creative platforms
Recent research focus: arXiv papers on self‑evolving agents, safety sufficiency for web world models, multimodal speech emotion recognition, and societal risk of surveillance‑assistant agents

digest.linkedin_post_draft: 🚀 **Agentic AI hiring is exploding!** In the last two years we’ve seen a **986 % surge in Agentic‑AI job listings** (2023 → 2024) and a **~280 % year‑on‑year increase in 2026**. Companies are racing to staff roles such as *Agentic AI Engineer, AI Agent Product Manager, AI Safety Engineer – Agents*, and *Autonomous‑Agent Platform Engineer*. The market isn’t just growing—it’s paying a premium: professionals who blend agentic‑AI expertise with regulated‑industry knowledge (finance, health‑care, legal) command **30‑50 % higher salaries**. If you’re looking to break into the field, focus on the four skill pillars recruiters are flagging: **orchestration & workflow design, RLHF/alignment, tool‑integration, and safety/observability**. The talent race is on—are you ready to join the next wave of autonomous‑agent builders?

training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will be able to design and implement safety guardrails for autonomous AI agents using threat‑modeling and audit frameworks.
key_points: Introduce safety‑by‑design principles for agentic systems
Hands‑on threat‑modeling with the grim‑prompter toolkit
Applying the better‑skill audit framework to score agent capabilities
Creating observability dashboards for runtime monitoring
Running safety verification tests before deployment

training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will construct end‑to‑end agent workflows that combine LLM orchestration with visual/3‑D content generation.
key_points: Designing agent orchestration and workflow graphs
Integrating prompt‑engineering and RLHF for language components
Connecting to visual pipelines using AgentFlux and anyscene
Managing data flow between text, image, and 3‑D assets
Deploying the pipeline on self‑hosted infrastructure

training_module_ideas.learning_objective: Learners will map core skill buckets to emerging job titles and understand salary premiums for domain‑specific expertise.
key_points: Review of core skill buckets recruiters flag
Breakdown of new job titles and typical responsibilities
Analysis of salary premium data for regulated‑industry expertise
